name: Sparse Voxel Octree Ray Traversal
definition: A ray traversal algorithm for a 3D sparse voxel octree implemented in a GLSL fragment shader. It uses parallel arrays to simulate a stack, handling valid internal nodes, leaf nodes, and empty space by casting rays to the next occupied voxel.
summary: Sparse Voxel Octree Ray Traversal is a hierarchical raycasting technique that efficiently renders 3D voxel data by traversing an implicit octree to skip empty space, differing from rasterization by requiring no mesh generation and using explicit backtracking for hierarchical descent.
